title: progressive disclosure
rule: Show only what is needed at the current step; reveal further fields as the user progresses (pages or conditional logic).

citation.source: NN/g — 4 Principles to Reduce Cognitive Load in Forms

pass_when: Only the current step’s needed fields are shown; later or conditional fields appear when relevant.
fail_when: Every possible question is visible at once on a long flow with no paging or conditionals.
overview: Only the current step’s needed fields are shown.
not_when: Not for the destructive decision inside a dialog.
agent_hint: Show only what is needed at the current step.
description: Show only what is needed at the current step. Only the current step’s needed fields are shown. It fails when Every possible question is visible at once on a long flow with no paging or conditionals.
